name: 88203 · Roswell, NM
findings: ZIP 88203 (Roswell) has 38 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 88203 (Roswell) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 88203 (Roswell) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 40% of the typical level).
